content: A roaring lion captures no prey.
author: African Proverbs
explanation: The hunter who broadcasts their arrival with deafening bellows warns every antelope across the savanna to flee. Loud boasting, constant social media announcements, and noisy declarations of ambition alert every obstacle to prepare. Move in dead, focused silence.
practicalInsight: Keep your next major goal or project completely secret today. Execute in silence and let the results announce themselves.
reflectionPrompt: Are you wasting your energy roaring about what you plan to accomplish instead of stalking the goal in silence?
